title: TagDuel lobby-expiry transaction rollback under SQLite write faults
scenarios: At the exact five-minute lobby deadline, a SQLite trigger aborts the tag_sessions update to status=expired. The original row, revision, event set, accepted-host lock and player collections must remain unchanged; after removing the trigger, retry expires the lobby and releases the host lock.

At the exact five-minute lobby deadline, a SQLite trigger aborts deletion of the accepted-host lock after the expiry row update. The transaction must roll back the row and lock together; retry expires the lobby and releases the lock without creating duel state or events.
invariants: The lobby expires at the exact five-minute deadline without extending on retry.
Status, revision and accepted-host lock are atomic.
A failed expiry does not leave an orphaned session or a partially released participant lock.
Player rows and player_cards remain unchanged; no starter cards or inventory are granted by expiry.
Expired lobbies have no duel state and no transition-event row.
limits: Tests use temporary SQLite and the real compiled TagStore module.
Fault injection covers SQL trigger aborts, not process termination or filesystem corruption.
No runtime, resolver, catalog manifest, allowlist, persistent database or player data is modified.
This is a lobby-storage regression and certifies no new card behavior.
No live Discord API session is performed.
command: npm run check && npm run build && node --test tests/tagLobbyExpiryRollbackAtomicity2v2.test.cjs
